subject: ai
question: What is a membership function in fuzzy logic?
title: Fuzzy: Degrees, Not Yes/No
hook: What if your weather app said it is 60% HOT?
answer: Membership function mu_A(x): maps each element x of the universe of discourse X to a degree of membership in [0,1]
mu=0: not in the set; mu=1: fully in; values between = partial membership
Common shapes: triangular, trapezoidal, Gaussian (also sigmoid)
Example: mu_HOT(30 C) = 0.5 on a ramp from 20 C (0) to 40 C (1)
